title: Eigenvalues
description: Some directions a matrix only stretches, never turns. How much it stretches them decides whether a system grows, shrinks or circles.

puzzle.goal: A 2 × 2 matrix has trace T and determinant D. Write the larger of the two amounts L it stretches its own directions by.
puzzle.name: Characteristic roots
puzzle.ask: Find L for T = @{T} and D = @{D}.
puzzle.method: They solve λ² − Tλ + D = 0: they add to T and multiply to D.
